name: brooksby-ops
description: Solopreneur OS — config-driven agents for solo consultants who run their business out of Notion, Gmail, Calendar, and Granola. Onboarding, daily check-in, meeting prep, meeting capture, Monday planner, and Friday wrap, plus a full content engine: wednesday-synthesis (weekly angles + forward theme map), draft-content (newsletter + variable-count LinkedIn posts, editable with variants), polish-and-score (voice + humanizer + newsletter-voice, LinkedIn post-scoring), mark-published (four-tracker publish sync), and collect-metrics. Optional content-vault hooks wire the planner, capture, and wrap into a local markdown vault.
